sentences.text: Paris is the debut studio album by American media personality , actress and singer Paris Hilton .	Paris Hilton	Paris Hilton	studio album	studio album
It was released on August 22 , 2006 by Warner Bros. .
The entire album was posted on AOL Music on August 14 , 2006 , becoming available for online stream eight days before the scheduled release date .	AOL Music	Spinner (website)
After getting signed to the label in 2005 , Hilton began working on the album with the producer Rob Cavallo , who was originally set to produce the entire record .	Rob Cavallo	Rob Cavallo
They recorded the song `` Screwed '' , which was intended to be the lead single .

However , after meeting with Scott Storch , Hilton decided to change the musical direction of the album and make more hip hop and R&B influenced songs .	R&B	Contemporary R&B	Scott Storch	Scott Storch	hip hop	Hip hop music

She collaborated with other producers , including Fernando Garibay , J.R. Rotem , Dr. Luke and Greg Wells .	Dr. Luke	Dr. Luke	Fernando Garibay	Fernando Garibay	Greg Wells	Greg Wells	J.R. Rotem	J.R. Rotem
Musically , Paris is a pop and R&B album that is influenced by hip hop .	R&B	Contemporary R&B	hip hop	Hip hop music	pop	pop music
It also incorporates elements of other genres , such as reggae , soul and pop rock , in its production .	pop	pop music	reggae	reggae	soul	soul music	pop rock	pop rock

Upon its release , Paris received generally mixed reviews from music critics , but noted a commercial success , peaking at number six on the Billboard 200 with first-week sales of 77,000 copies .	music critics	Music journalism
As of October 2013 , the album has sold 200,000 copies in the United States and over 600,000 copies worldwide .
Three singles were released from the album .
`` Stars Are Blind '' was released as the lead single on June 5 , 2006 to critical acclaim .	Stars Are Blind	Stars Are Blind
It peaked at number 18 on the Billboard Hot 100 and became one of the highest debuting singles of 2006 .
The second single , `` Turn It Up '' , managed to be successful on the Billboard Hot Dance Club Songs , peaking at number one .	Turn It Up	Turn It Up (Paris Hilton song)
`` Nothing in This World '' , the album 's third and final single , was released on August 28 and peaked at number 12 on the Hot Dance Club Songs chart .	Nothing in This World	Nothing in This World
